scope: Encoded: s 45A(a)-(f) with s 47(c), declining where its limits cut sums credited at two rates; s 47(a)(1)-(8) and (b), (b1), (b2), (d) (refused); s 40(b)(1), (1A), (1A1), (1B), (2), (3); ss 37, 38, 39; s 35(a)-(d) with both texts of (a)(1) selected by Amendment 262 s 2, (e) refused; s 1 'Israeli resident' (a) for an individual (a recorded finding of the centre of life, or the day-count presumptions), (a)(4) and s 14(b) refused; s 1 'work income' and s 2's territorial charge and sources; s 64B(a)-(d); s 65. Inert: s 40(a) (a cross-reference to the National Insurance Law), s 40(c), s 45A(a)(2), s 47(a)(2) and (6), s 2(3), s 64B(e), s 121A (repealed). Reached and refused: the s 48 order (for s 37) and the s 48A Regulations (for ss 35, 37-39, 40(b), 45A). Out of this row: the National Health Insurance Law and s 164 with its Regulations (each needs its own source deposit); ss 39A, 39B, 40A-40F, 41, 44-46C and 47A (outside the ruled scope); s 66 (row IL-02), s 120B (row IL-03). Tax years from 2024; the amounts ss 45A and 47 print are inputs, with the Tax Authority's 2024-2026 figures carried as published figures, not law.
tax_years_answered: from 2024; a year after 2026 on the text at retrieval (a projection)
